name: Mandarin Oriental Conservatorium, Amsterdam
funFact: This hotel began as the Rijkspostspaarbank headquarters, built in 1899–1901 by Rijksbouwmeester Daniël Knuttel. It housed the Sweelinck Conservatorium from 1985 to 2008 before becoming a hotel in 2011. Its modern steel-and-glass atrium contrasts with the preserved brick and stone bank building. Mandarin Oriental adopted its current name in January 2026.
description: Historic bank and former music school, now a hotel; Rijksmonument287. Public hotel entrance on Paulus Potterstraat50; chosen pin near that sourced public entrance rather than inaccessible court centroid.
